prompt:
Design a finished high-fidelity desktop web application screen for Fretwave, French guitar practice software. Edge-to-edge landscape 3:2 screenshot, sharp readable typography, no device or browser framing. This is an alternative stronger composition to the previous image, not an incremental recoloring.

Art direction: an independent contemporary guitar journal translated into restrained functional software. Solid deep petrol-blue left navigation occupying about one sixth of the screen, pale mineral-blue background, white central practice area, burnt orange play action. Flat surfaces, no gradients, no decorative shadows. Beautiful humanist sans, purposeful larger bold condensed title, tabular measurement digits. Signature: a vertical position selector with large 01–05 numbers, the active 01 orange, placed alongside the musical work area like a quiet index. Clean thin dividers; one continuous work surface rather than stacked cards.

Nav: “Fretwave” wordmark, “Gammes” active, “Accords”, “Accordeur”, “Métronome”; bottom “Réglages”, “Compte facultatif”, “Disponible hors ligne”. Main title “La pentatonique mineure”. Small selectors “La”, “Pentatonique mineure”, “Accordage standard”. Below: “Découvrir”, “Séquences” active, “Improviser”. Main work area: “Gamme en boucle” selected beside “Motifs”, “Liaisons”. Then “Position 1 · Cases 5–8” and a very large clean six-string tablature preview, plenty of whitespace. Tablature illustrates ascending notes: strings top to bottom e B G D A E, chronological notes start bottom E 5 then 8, then A 5 7, D 5 7, G 5 7, B 5 8, top e 5 8. Twelve separate horizontal note positions, never simultaneous notes. A quiet “Voir le manche” link. Position choices 01–05 show no invented fret ranges.

Bottom integrated transport: “80 BPM” with minus/plus, “Tempo fixe” selector, “Micro désactivé” and “Activer”, generous orange “Démarrer”. Helper: “Sans micro, joue librement, sans évaluation.” Top right quiet link “Réviser mes formes”. Refined spacious alignment, genuinely useful while holding a guitar. No dashboard, statistics, badges, photograph, poster layout, old neon or pixel styling.
